Definition: Elnathan, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elnathan is the name of four Israelites. In 2 Kings 24:8, the text says "the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem." The life behind the name is told on the Elnathan People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elnathan matters because God knows His people by name, and Elnathan is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
